vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: pdf-to-csv
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is a standard API integration for the third-party service pdfapihub.com, designed to convert PDF documents to CSV format. All files (SKILL.md, skill.json, and example.json) consistently describe this functionality, and the data flow (sending PDF content or URLs to https://pdfapihub.com/api) is aligned with the stated purpose. No evidence of prompt injection, unauthorized data exfiltration, or malicious execution was found.

llm.summary: The skill's behavior (posting PDFs to pdfapihub.com and requiring an API key) matches its description, but the registry metadata omits the required credential and the skill will transmit your PDF data to a third party — verify the provider before use.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the actions described in SKILL.md (convert PDF tables/text to CSV). However, SKILL.md and skill.json require an API key sent as CLIENT-API-KEY in requests, while the registry metadata lists no required credential — an inconsistency in declared requirements.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped: accept a PDF (URL, base64, or multipart) and POST it to https://pdfapihub.com to get CSV output. There are no instructions to read local system files, environment secrets, or unrelated config paths.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files; nothing is written to disk or installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires an API key header (per SKILL.md and skill.json) but the registry metadata declares no required environment variables or primary credential. This mismatch could confuse users and the platform about how credentials are provided. Also, supplying PDFs (possibly sensitive) will transmit them to a third-party service (pdfapihub.com).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Does not request persistent/always-on privileges and uses normal, user-invoked operation. No evidence of modifying other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says (upload a PDF to pdfapihub.com and return CSV), but before installing or using it: 1) Confirm you trust pdfapihub.com — check its privacy/retention policy and reputation because your PDFs (and extracted data) will be sent to that third party. 2) Note the registry metadata does not list the API key requirement even though SKILL.md and skill.json require CLIENT-API-KEY; ask the publisher to correct the metadata or confirm how the key should be provided. 3) Avoid uploading sensitive or regulated documents unless you have explicit assurance about data handling. 4) If you need local-only processing for privacy, consider local tools (e.g., tabula/camelot) instead of a hosted API.
